name: Head & Neurological
hazardEffects: Cephalad fluid shift causes elevated intracranial pressure, sinus congestion, space headaches, and potential cognitive fatigue.

name: Eyes & Vision (SANS)
hazardEffects: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) leads to optic disc edema, posterior globe flattening, and hyperopic refractive shifts.

name: Heart & Circulatory
hazardEffects: Cardiac muscle remodeling, reduced left ventricular mass, orthostatic intolerance upon gravity return, altered cardiac rhythm.

name: Lungs & Respiratory
hazardEffects: Particulate accumulation in closed habitat, altered ventilation-perfusion ratios in weightlessness, toxic trace contaminant risks.

name: GI & Digestive
hazardEffects: Space Motion Sickness (SMS) in first 72 hours; gastrointestinal prodromal nausea/vomiting marker under acute ionizing solar radiation.

name: Spine & Musculoskeletal
hazardEffects: 1.0-1.5% bone mineral density loss per month in weight-bearing bones, muscle atrophy, spinal elongation (5-7 cm) and intervertebral back pain.

name: Immune & Radiation Dose
hazardEffects: T-cell function suppression, latent viral reactivation (EBV, VZV), cutaneous erythema if exposed to high-energy solar particle events.

name: Cognitive & Behavioral
hazardEffects: Earth-out-of-view phenomenon, sensory monotony, acute sleep deficiency, communication latency stress (up to 22 min one-way Mars delay).
